summary: Recent updates in the Fake Cdm area have focused on enhancing code efficiency by removing the unused `sShutdownMode` global in the `cdm-test-decryptor.cpp` file. This change helps streamline the testing environment for Content Decryption Modules (CDM), which are essential for managing the playback of DRM-protected content. While this update does not bring any direct changes to user-facing features, it contributes to a cleaner and more maintainable codebase, ensuring smoother functionality in handling media formats.
